svg.title: Equal ratios enclose equal logarithmic areas
svg.desc: The hyperbola y=1/t has shaded areas on [1,2] in blue and [3,6] in violet. Both areas equal ln 2. The map (t,y) to (3t,y/3) sends the first area to the second, multiplying horizontal lengths by 3 and vertical lengths by one third.
